task: Reverse-transfer pinned Astra N35 molecular jump safety into a predictable-control stochastic-process result.

claims.statement: For a pure-jump X^V with finite marks nu_r/V and predictable intensities V lambda_r(t), stopped on first exit tau from Q={x:g_i(x)=a_i·x+b_i>=0}, suppose before tau that |a_i·nu_r|<=J_i, sum_r lambda_r<=Lambda, sum_r lambda_r(a_i·nu_r)^2<=B_i, and sum_r lambda_r(a_i·nu_r)>=mu_i in 0<=g_i(X^V_{t-})<=ell_i. With theta_i=min(1/J_i,mu_i/(3B_i)) and c=min_i theta_i ell_i, P(tau<=T)<=sum_i exp(-theta_i V g_i(X^V_0))+2mV Lambda T exp(-cV) for every finite T. If each initial gap is at least d_i>0, then for fixed alpha<c and time unit t_0, P(tau<=t_0 exp(alpha V))<=m exp(-c_0 V)+2mV Lambda t_0 exp(-(c-alpha)V), c_0=min_i theta_i d_i.
assumptions: Predictable compensators V lambda_r(t)dt; pure jumps and no simultaneous marked jumps up to tau.
Initial state in Q; a buffer is required for an exponentially small first term.
Bounds hold almost surely for almost every pre-exit time and uniformly over admitted predictable controls.
Pre-exit total hazard is bounded by V Lambda, so the stopped process is nonexplosive on finite intervals.
J_i,B_i>0 for each proper active facet.
claims.status: Internally reconstructed; standard stopped exponential-Lyapunov/Dynkin proof; external review and priority unresolved.
claims.novelty_boundary: The probability mechanism is generic. Chemistry contributes no sharper bound once drift, jump, variance, and activity conditions are supplied.

costs.simulation: Rate-V Lambda thinning uses at most V Lambda T expected proposals; controller evaluation is additional.

claims.falsifier: A process satisfying all predictable pointwise bounds but violating the displayed inequality would refute the lemma; none found.
claims.next_gate: Independent review of marked-point-process/Dynkin hypotheses and a theorem-level search for switched or predictable-control variants.

claims.statement: For integer-complex stochastic mass action on 0<=x_j<=U_j, phi^V_y(x)=V^{-|y|} product_j(Vx_j)_{y_j} obeys 0<=x^y-phi^V_y(x)<=E_y(U)/V even when a reactant is insufficient, where E_y(U)=sum_{j:y_j>=2}binom(y_j,2)U_j^(y_j-1) product_{l!=j}U_l^(y_l). A deterministic collar margin gamma_i uniform over k in [0,K] therefore gives stochastic inward drift at least gamma_i-D_i/V, D_i=K sum_r|a_i·nu_r|E_{y_r}(U); V>=max(1,max_i ceil(2D_i/gamma_i)) gives mu_i=gamma_i/2.
assumptions: Integer nonnegative molecular complexes and count-lattice state.
Actual falling-factorial propensity, rate cap K, and coordinate bounds U.
Deterministic certificate uniform over all allowed rates and the stated collar.

claims.statement: For 2A->A+B and 2B->A+B at predictable rates 1<=k_A,k_B<=4, even V, total A+B=V, initial A=B=V/2, and Q=[1/4,3/4] in x=A/V, the exact birth/death-ratio calculation gives P(tau_Q<=T)<=2exp(-3V/25)+(108/35)VT exp(-3V/200). At T=exp(3V/400), V=3000 gives a bound below 1.57e-6; nevertheless, for every even V>=6, fixed positive constant rates yield a finite irreducible class A=1,...,V-1 which exits Q almost surely.
assumptions: Even V, conserved total V, initial counts A=B=V/2.
